## Activity

Oakridge Primary Care completed 70 captures during June 2019. This report provides a summary of activity, image quality and grading outcomes for the month. The activity figure should be considered alongside the quality and grading information below when reviewing site operations.

## Image quality

Of the captures completed, 2 were ungradable. This represents an ungradable rate of 2.9 per cent. The ungradable captures should be considered as part of routine quality monitoring, with any recurring equipment or image issues recorded for follow-up. The clinic lead asks that recurring camera issues are logged with the service desk.

## Grading

There were 8 referable results during June 2019. The median grading wait was 2 days. These results provide the monthly grading position for Oakridge Primary Care and should be retained with the site’s operational records. Continued monitoring of image quality, grading outcomes and grading waits will support identification of any recurring issues requiring service desk attention.
